note: v3335: READING CI AFTER A SHIP FOUND THREE GATES RED THAT ARE MINE, AND THEY SHARE ONE CAUSE. v3326 refactored three expressions in control_ui.html and three separate laws or proofs pinned the OLD SPELLINGS. It also demanded the one-word unmeasured-to-NEVER form that v3309 deliberately split in two on his report that the screen said NEVER about a row asked two minutes ago. TWO: test_screen_parity pinned the pre-hoist spelling in BOTH its body and its red-proof, so heart2 reported a proof matching zero times, which in turn reddened the heart gate. That law is deliberately NOT a ban, because a lock nothing may ever ask is a badge; the feeder asks at the ONE seat that writes, fails closed on every refusal, banks names the door already gated and removes nothing, so it is declared rather than exempted and the absolute half, no deleter may ask, is untouched. 6 red-proofs PROVEN across the three gates. Anchor on something unique and count before believing it.
